title: Incident response
brief: Now you are the defender. Halcyon's admin account was used at 3 a.m. Find who did it from the authentication log.
hint.1: The playbook tells you what to look for. cat /opt/ir/playbook.txt
hint.2: grep Failed /var/log/auth.log shows the guessing. Which IP repeats?
hint.3: grep Accepted shows who got in. The IP that failed first and then succeeded is the attacker.
walkthrough: grep Accepted /var/log/auth.log. The attacker is 203.0.113.50. Submit flag{203.0.113.50}.
debrief: Many failures from one address followed by a success is brute force. You caught it from logs alone. Defenders: rate-limit logins, require MFA, alert on this pattern, and layer controls so one failure is not fatal (defense in depth).
objective.grep: Search the auth log with grep
